h_del_pin: «X pinned a message» notices are deleted.
h_del_chatinfo: Notices about a new title or photo are deleted.
h_del_cmds: A command Aegis acted on (/ban, /report …) is deleted after.
h_del_bots: Messages of bots that aren't admins are deleted.
h_notice_ttl: Aegis's notices in the group delete themselves after this time.
h_slow: A member must wait this long between messages (admins too can set Telegram's own).
h_max_lines: Messages with more lines are deleted.
h_max_mentions: Messages mentioning more people are deleted (anti mass-tag).
h_caps: Messages written mostly in CAPITALS are deleted.
h_junk: Messages of only dots, symbols or punctuation are deleted.
h_edit_window: Editing a message later than this deletes it (no bait-and-switch).
h_media_ttl: Photos, videos and files of members delete themselves after this time.
h_reply_private: Answers to member commands go to their private chat.
h_admin_call: Writing @admin tells the admins privately (once every 5 minutes).
h_anon_cmds: Commands of the anonymous admin run once a real admin confirms them with a button.
h_jr_mode: What happens to join requests when the captcha doesn't handle them.
h_name_watch: Members' name and username changes are reported.
h_title_lock: The group's title is put back if someone changes it.
h_bot_alert: Admins are told whenever a bot is added.
h_bot_kick: A bot added by a member who isn't an admin is removed at once (admins may add bots).
x_intro_w: Greet newcomers (after the captcha, if there is one) and say goodbye. Your own text may use {name}, {mention}, {group} and {count}; buttons are lines like «Text - https://link».
x_intro_j: Members must join these channels or groups (Aegis must be an admin there) — or add some people — before they can write. Until then their messages are deleted with a notice.
x_intro_n: The group closes for members every night and opens in the morning. The permissions it had are put back.
x_intro_c: Up to 5 times a day Aegis deletes the messages it saw since the last cleanup (Telegram allows up to 48 hours). Admins' messages stay.
x_intro_z: Used for the night lock and scheduled cleanup.
x_intro_l: Text messages shorter than the minimum, or messages longer than the maximum, are deleted.
x_intro_r: Members reply to a message with /report (or «report») to tell the admins; they act with one button.
x_intro_e: A channel or group that gets the members' events: joins, leaves, admin changes, name changes.
x_intro_k: What happens to the linked channel's posts that Telegram copies into this group.
x_intro_u: Shown by /rules and the welcome's «Rules» button.
stop_bots: 🤖 Messages of other bots are removed here.
stop_edit: ✏️ {user}, edits later than {time} min are removed.
stop_fj: 📢 {user}, join our channel first ({n} left), then press «I joined».
stop_fa: ➕ {user}, add {n} more members to write here (needed: {total}).
stop_slow: 🐢 {user}, slow mode: one message every {time} s.
stop_max: 📏 {user}, messages may have at most {n} characters.
p_welcome_text: Send the welcome text. You may use {name}, {mention}, {group} and {count}. Send «-» for the standard text.
p_welcome_btns: Send the buttons, one row per line: «Text - https://link» (several in a row with « | »). Send «-» for none.
p_goodbye_text: Send the goodbye text ({name} and {group} work). Send «-» for the standard text.
p_rules: Send the group's rules (up to 3000 characters). Send «-» to remove them.
p_night_times: Send the night hours as «from - to», e.g. «23:00 - 07:00».
p_clean_times: Send up to {max} times of day, e.g. «03:00, 15:30».
p_fj_add: Pick the channel or group members must join with the buttons below (Aegis must be an admin there, and you too), forward a post from it, or send @username or the -100… id.
p_ev_set: Pick the event channel or group with the buttons below (Aegis must be able to post there, and you must be an admin there), forward a post, or send @username or the -100… id.
times_err_empty: Send at least one time, e.g. «03:00».
home_intro: 26 advanced settings in four groups, and the extras below. Admins, VIP and trusted members are never caught by these rules.
fj_bot_not_admin: Aegis must be an admin of that channel to check who joined it.
night_on: 🌙 Good night! The group is closed for members until {time}.
clean_q: Delete the messages Aegis saw in {title} in the last 48 hours (admins' messages stay)?
cleanup_audit: 🕵️ Audit Mode — the cleanup would have deleted {n} messages
ev_connected: ✅ This chat now receives the member events of {title}.
no_rules: No rules have been written yet.
log_audit: 🕵️ Audit Mode — would have deleted a message of {user}: {rule}
admin_called_none: 📣 {user}, no admin can be reached privately right now — please wait.
title_restored: 🔒 {user} changed the title to {title}; Aegis put back {locked}.
title_changed_audit: 🕵️ Audit Mode — {user} changed the title to {title} (locked title: {locked}).
anon_confirm: 🕶 An anonymous admin sent a command. An admin, please confirm it — it will run as yours.
report_usage: 🚨 {user}, reply to the message you want to report with /report [reason].
report_thanks: ✅ {user}, thanks — the admins have been told.
rp_denied: Only admins can do this (mute and ban need the right to ban users).
rp_muted: 🔇 Deleted and muted for a day.
bot_kicked: 🤖 {user} added {bots}; Aegis removed it (only admins may add bots).
bot_kick_audit: 🕵️ Audit Mode — {user} added {bots} (would have been removed).
